embeds.title: 🛠️  Guild Board 1.4.0 is out
embeds.description:
Bug fix patch. Your reports got squashed, the minimap button moved outside the circle, and the addon now nags you itself when you fall behind.

**[⬇️  Download 1.4.0](https://github.com/KrisHendo09/guild-board/releases/latest)**  then restart WoW

footer: Something busted? Type /gb bug in game  ·  For the Horde
